resolution.note: ship releases the claim of a merged closed task; state check releases claims of closed tasks

title: ship and state check release claims of closed tasks
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: `krn ship` and `krn task close` never released task claims; 31 claims of closed tasks sat in .krn/task-claims and `krn state check` reported each as state-loss until the lead released them by hand.
Outcome: ship releases the claim of a task once its PR merged with that task closed, and `krn state check` treats a claim of a closed task as stale (released, not state-loss).
Why: every session start paid for false state-loss errors.
Proof: a ship test whose merged PR closes a claimed task leaves no claim file; a state test with a claim of a closed task exits 0 and removes it.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, src/state/, src/task/
